subject: Your action items from yesterday
preview_text: One tap to find what you forgot. No more lost notes.
body_paragraphs: Real talk: You walked out of your last meeting thinking you'd remember everything. But by lunch, three action items were already fuzzy. That's not your fault — it's how human memory works.

Here's the one trick that takes 60 seconds: Open your last summary in Smart Notes and tap the "Action Items" section. It's already there, pulled from the transcript by AI. Review it for 30 seconds, then forward it to your team or yourself. That's it. You just turned chaos into clarity.
I call this the "Two-Minute Monday" habit. Users who do it once report feeling 3x more organized for the rest of the week. And they're the ones who keep coming back because it actually works.

Try it now: Open Smart Notes, find your most recent meeting, and tap the summary. One scroll, one review, one forward. That's all. P.S. The search bar also finds any word you said — type "budget" or "deadline" and watch the magic.
